events.text: Please fix the seed-packet counter for our imaginary moon garden. When tray slips are imported, the count must describe actual packets, not how many times slips were loaded. Separately, make a simple planting-day sign. The sign is a small side project, not something the counter needs before it can work.

I will use the number of accepted slip rows as the success measure. I assume packet labels must be unique across the whole garden, so I will discard every later row with the same label. That should prevent double counting. I have not changed anything yet.
Sample slips: tray amber, packet 7, label silverleaf; tray violet, packet 7, label silverleaf. The sample inventory has two physical packets. The proposed label filter retains one row.

Labels are not unique. Keep both of those packets. A packet is identified by the pair of tray name and packet code, and loading the same slips again must not add packets. If a slip has no packet code, reject the entire import with a clear error. Keep this correction separate from the sign work.
